title: Grateful Dead Live at Alpine Valley Music Theatre on 1989-07-17
lineage: Nakamichi DR-1 > dbx224x > Korg MR-1 DSD [1 Bit 2.8 khz] Mastering: Audio Gate to [24/96] > WaveLab > Nomad Blue Tube Limiter LM2S-3 > r8brain to [16/44.1] > CD Wave > TLH > Flac
source: Sennheiser 441 > Marantz PDM 340 w/ dbx (Cassette Master Maxell MX-S 90)

ai_review.summary: Excellent audience recording of a July 17‑1989 Alpine Valley show highlighted by a blazing “Standing on the Moon” and a memorable Dark Star.
ai_review.review: Fans rave about the warm, vivid atmosphere captured on this audience tape – it sounds “awesome” and delivers the energy of a classic late‑summer Dead run. The second set shines with a scorching “Standing on the Moon” and an inspiring Dark Star, while the first set is solid but less remarkable. Minor recording quirks (a flat mix and a drum/space cut) don’t detract from overall enjoyment.

ai_rating.rationale: All substantive reviews are 4‑5 stars, praising the performance (especially the second set) and noting only modest recording imperfections.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Clear, lively audience tape with a slightly flat mix reminiscent of a soundboard; one reviewer notes a cut in the drums/space segment but overall the tape is listenable and captures the crowd vibe.

show_quality.setlist_flow: First set described as solid and standard; second set is the real shiner, building from a blazing “Standing on the Moon” into extended improvisations.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Repeatedly praised for his tone and stage presence (rare red pocket tee, lovely playing).
